name: FusedQuantMatmul

bias.description: shape varies; supports float32; optional, may be None

y.description: Output tensor after fused quant matmul + dequant + bias + gelu

description: Fused quantized matrix multiplication with dequantization, bias addition, and optional GELU activation. Steps: (1) optional transpose, (2) matmul in float32, (3) dequantize using x1scale/x2scale, (4) add bias (int32 adds before dequant, float adds after), (5) optional GELU (gelu_erf or gelu_tanh), (6) cast to output dtype. x1/x2 are int8, scales are float32, bias is optional.
